_doc: Hand-curated Haki codex — the three core types + advanced variants. Each entry: name, kind, debut chapter, key practitioners, what it does, advanced form notes.

haki.name: Observation Haki
haki.summary: Sense the presence, intent, and emotion of others. Allows brief future-sight at advanced levels.
haki.advanced: Future Sight — see seconds ahead. Mastered by Katakuri, awakened by Luffy in Whole Cake.

haki.name: Armament Haki
haki.summary: Coat the body or weapon in invisible armour. Hardens flesh, bypasses Logia intangibility, increases striking power.
haki.advanced: Internal Destruction (Ryuou Flow) — emit Haki without contact, attack the inside of enemies. Used by Luffy from Wano onward, taught by the Mink tribe.

haki.name: Conqueror's Haki
haki.summary: The will to dominate. Knocks weak-willed opponents unconscious. Possessed by ~1 in a million.
haki.advanced: Coating (Haoshoku Imbue) — coat weapon/limbs in Conqueror's, dealing damage at a distance via shockwave-like crackling black lightning. Luffy and Kaidou used this on Onigashima.

haki.name: Future Sight
haki.japanese: 見聞色の覇気 (Kenbunshoku no Haki)
haki.summary: Awakened Observation. See a few seconds into the future — useful for dodging the impossible.
haki.advanced: Limited duration; mental strain. Luffy unlocked it during the Katakuri fight.

haki.name: Ryuou (Flow)
haki.summary: Wano-style Armament — emit Haki without physical contact. Bypasses defences by attacking through them.
haki.advanced: Mastered version: Luffy's Internal Destruction-class strikes during the Onigashima rooftop fight.

haki.name: Conqueror's Coating
haki.japanese: 覇王色の覇気 / 武器に纏わせる
haki.summary: Coat strikes in Conqueror's — black-lightning crackle, ranged damage. Said to be wielded by only the highest-tier emperors and the Pirate King's class.
haki.advanced: First clearly named in the rooftop showdown. Distinctive black-and-red lightning effect.

haki.name: Mantra
haki.summary: Skypiea's name for Observation Haki. Aisa is born with it; Enel uses it to monitor an entire sky island.
haki.advanced: Same as Observation Haki — Skypiea simply names it differently, as the rest of the world hadn't yet revealed Haki to readers.
